subject: Manifest domains partly clarified; compiler-bound view fields still cannot be final
body:
ACK separation of VkViewFormat vs MetalViewFormat in the runtime wire, corrected shape mapping, and base/relative-level split. However the compiler manifest is NOT final yet: tegu_mali_compile_compute_v2 takes SPIR-V+scalar specializations only, so it cannot know bound view_format, view_level or view_layer. These must be reserved-zero in the compiler manifest, or their semantics/API must explicitly supply the selected bound plan; guessing bound Vk view is invalid. Distinguish declared storage image format (compiler-known) from sampled view format (runtime-known). Lowering is choosing an exact compiler-emittable stable format/shape domain now. Document named dimensions and numeric-class values, depth/shadow meaning and illegal combinations, irrelevant fields for UBO/SSBO/SAMPLER/dummy allzero, and cross-kind collision rule permitting only a genuinely combined TEX+SAM binding. Storage atomic semantics must produce writable BO and appropriate read/write access; no atomic-only->read fallback.

Your advertised single-level16-plane path is a scoped implementation, not full texture support: current broader render helper supports up to256subresources. Keep missing fullmip wire and layers>16 outcomes explicit. Selected view level may need a one-level runtime view with adjusted dims/base, but current Rust refuses nonzero level; do not claim image mip access. Please add current STATUS plus schema table before requesting compiler implementation. Corrections to source are visible and useful, but a final reproducible package/producer test and exact schema ACK remain required.
